---
output:
  html_document:
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    mathjax: null
    toc: false
    self_contained: true
params:
  lCharts: NA
  dfResults: NA
  dfMetrics: NA
  dfGroups: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.kri)

setup <- Report_Setup(
  dfResults = params$dfResults,
  dfMetrics = params$dfMetrics,
  dfGroups = params$dfGroups
)
dfResults_current <- FilterByLatestSnapshotDate(params$dfResults)

# Inactive metrics are listed last and excluded from headline counts (#325).
vInactive <- gsm.kri:::v2_inactive_ids(params$dfMetrics)
dfMetrics <- params$dfMetrics[order(params$dfMetrics$MetricID %in% vInactive), ]
```

---
pagetitle: "`r setup$StudyLabel` · `r setup$GroupLevel` KRI Report"
---

```{r v2-report}
# Flags over time, when deltas are available (Overview tab).
flagOverTime <- NULL
if (any(grepl("_Change", names(params$dfResults)))) {
  strSnapshotDates <- unique(params$dfResults$SnapshotDate) %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
    head(12L)
  dfResultsFlagged <- params$dfResults %>%
    FilterByFlags(bCurrentlyFlagged = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$SnapshotDate %in% strSnapshotDates)

  flagOverTime <- htmltools::tags$details(
    class = "v2-card v2-fot",
    htmltools::tags$summary(
      htmltools::tags$span(class = "v2-fot-title", "Flags over time"),
      htmltools::tags$span(class = "v2-section-sub", glue::glue("{length(strSnapshotDates)} most recent snapshots, risk signals flagged in the latest one"))
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "v2-fot-body gsm-widget flagOverTime",
      Widget_FlagOverTime(
        dfResults = dfResultsFlagged,
        dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
        strGroupLevel = setup$GroupLevel,
        bExcludeEver = TRUE
      )
    )
  )
}

# Metrics tab: KRI cards ordered by severity, inactive last, matching the KRI list.
lSummary <- gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Summary(dfResults_current, dfMetrics)
dfCounts <- gsm.kri:::v2_metric_counts(dfResults_current, dfMetrics)
metricCards <- lapply(dfCounts$MetricID, function(strMetricID) {
  lCharts <- params$lCharts[[strMetricID]]
  if (is.null(lCharts)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  lMetric <- dfMetrics %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$MetricID == strMetricID) %>%
    as.list()
  gsm.kri:::ReportV2_MetricCard(lCharts, lMetric, dfResults_current)
})
intCollapsed <- sum(!dfCounts$inactive & dfCounts$red + dfCounts$amber == 0)
intInactive <- sum(dfCounts$inactive)

# Sites tab.
lSiteData <- gsm.kri:::ReportV2_SiteData(params$dfResults, dfMetrics, params$dfGroups, params$lCharts)

tab_panel <- function(strTab, ..., bHidden = TRUE) {
  htmltools::tags$section(
    class = "v2-tabpanel",
    id = paste0("v2-panel-", strTab),
    role = "tabpanel",
    `data-tabpanel` = strTab,
    `aria-labelledby` = paste0("v2-tab-", strTab),
    hidden = if (bHidden) NA,
    ...
  )
}

htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "v2-root",
  gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Dependencies(),
  gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Topbar(setup, dfResults_current, params$dfGroups, dfMetrics),
  htmltools::tags$main(
    class = "v2-main",
    gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Masthead(setup),
    gsm.kri:::ReportV2_TabBar(
      setup$GroupLevel,
      list(sites = nrow(lSiteData$sites), metrics = sum(!dfCounts$inactive))
    ),
    tab_panel(
      "overview",
      bHidden = FALSE,
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "v2-overview-top",
        gsm.kri:::ReportV2_KPICards(lSummary, setup$GroupLevel),
        gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Takeaways(lSummary, dfResults_current, dfMetrics, params$dfGroups)
      ),
      gsm.kri:::ReportV2_FlagChanges(params$dfResults, dfMetrics, params$dfGroups),
      flagOverTime
    ),
    tab_panel("sites", gsm.kri:::ReportV2_SitesTab(lSiteData)),
    tab_panel(
      "metrics",
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "v2-split v2-metrics",
        htmltools::tags$div(
          class = "v2-pane-left",
          gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Nav(params$dfResults, dfMetrics)
        ),
        htmltools::tags$div(
          class = "v2-metrics-main",
          htmltools::tags$div(
            class = "v2-section-head",
            htmltools::tags$div(
              htmltools::tags$h2("Key risk indicators"),
              htmltools::tags$p(class = "v2-section-sub", "Sorted by severity. KRIs without red or amber flags start collapsed.")
            ),
            htmltools::tags$div(
              class = "v2-seg",
              htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", `data-v2-expand` = "expand", "Expand all"),
              htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", `data-v2-expand` = "collapse", "Collapse all")
            )
          ),
          metricCards,
          if (intCollapsed + intInactive > 0) {
            htmltools::tags$p(
              class = "v2-collapse-note",
              paste(c(
                if (intCollapsed > 0) sprintf("%d KRI%s without flags %s collapsed.", intCollapsed, if (intCollapsed == 1) "" else "s", if (intCollapsed == 1) "is" else "are"),
                if (intInactive > 0) sprintf("%d inactive KRI%s %s listed last and excluded from flag counts.", intInactive, if (intInactive == 1) "" else "s", if (intInactive == 1) "is" else "are")
              ), collapse = " ")
            )
          },
          gsm.kri:::ReportV2_MetricReference(dfMetrics)
        )
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$footer(
      class = "v2-footer",
      htmltools::tags$span(paste("Generated by gsm.kri", utils::packageVersion("gsm.kri"))),
      htmltools::tags$span(paste(setup$StudyLabel, "\u00B7 snapshot", setup$SnapshotDate))
    )
  )
)
```
